subject: Request: Interim seat slice refund + collection hold pending VAT evidence
messages:
From: Ava Caulfield <ava@heliosbio.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.example
Cc: billing@heliosbio.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Interim seats added 10/1 — request pause on collection and refund guidance

Hi Jonas,

We added 18 additional seats on Oct 1 to cover a short-term pilot and just received the Oct invoice that charged those seats for the full month. Our procurement policy requires VAT evidence before we can move forward with payment in the EU. Can you confirm if Redwood can: 1) pause collections on the Oct invoice while we upload VAT documentation, and 2) issue a prorated credit for the period 10/1–10/12 (we're returning the pilot seats on 10/12)?

I attached a CSV snapshot of usage for the seat burst (usage_snapshot_20261001-11.csv). We need the refund to be visible as a separate credit line on the final invoice (not just an internal memo) so our accounting team can reconcile.

Please advise next steps and the documentation you need — happy to route a VAT certificate or a PO.

Thanks,
Ava Caulfield
Head of Procurement
Helios Bio

Attachments: usage_snapshot_20261001-11.csv (csv stub)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.example
To: Ava Caulfield <ava@heliosbio.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.example, marissa_cole@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interim seats added 10/1 — request pause on collection and refund guidance

Thanks for the note, Ava — and for the usage CSV.

Quick answers up front: yes, we can put the invoice on collection hold while you provide VAT evidence, and yes, we will generate a separate credit line for the prorated period once the charge is validated. To proceed we'll need:

- A copy of your EU VAT registration (certificate or equivalent) tied to the billing entity on file.
- If you prefer, a PO number so we can reference it on the credit memo.

Operational plan (what we'll do on our side):
- Finance will place the invoice (INV-8872) on a 14-day collection hold after we receive the VAT file.
- We will calculate the prorated credit for 18 seats from 10/01–10/12 and post a credit memo referencing INV-8872 and DL-78921.
- The credit will appear as a separate line item on the updated invoice; we will also upload the credit memo PDF to the invoice thread and share a DocuSign link if a signature is required.

I've attached a provisional credit calc I prepared so you have an early estimate. This is preliminary pending confirmation of billing entity and VAT status.

Laura (billing ops) and Marissa (finance) are looped for the hold and credit processing. Laura — can you confirm the timeline on posting the credit and whether accounting needs any further PO/PO-attachment format to mark the invoice as withheld?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.example | +1 415-555-0191

Attachments: provisional_credit_calc_20261012.xlsx (xls stub)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.example

Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.example, marissa_cole@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interim seats added 10/1 — request pause on collection and refund guidance

Hi Ava — Laura from Billing here. Quick process note and the specific items we'll post once we receive evidence: 

1) Evidence required: VAT registration certificate showing the billing entity name + VAT number matching the invoice. PDFs are fine. If the VAT registration is in a different legal name, please include a short note tying it to the Helios billing entity.

2) Hold: We will mark INV-8872 "Payment Hold - VAT Pending" in our AR system within 24 hours of receipt. That will pause dunning and collections notices for 14 days. If docs are still outstanding after 14 days we'll reach back out for next steps.

3) Credit calculation: Based on the provisional calc we will: credit 18 seats prorated for 11 days (10/1–10/11 inclusive) since you indicated seat return on 10/12 — please confirm if charge should be removed starting 10/12 or last billable day is 10/11.

4) Posting & visibility: The credit memo will be a separate line item referencing INV-8872 and DL-78921 and will show VAT treatment (reverse charge or zero-rated) depending on the certificate. We'll also produce an updated invoice PDF and upload to the DocuSign preview link so your AP can download.

PO request: if you can reply with a PO number we'll include it on the credit memo and on the invoice revision to speed reconciliation.

Estimated timing once we have the VAT cert + PO: credit posted within 48 business hours, invoice revision available same day.

Let me know if you'd like a short call to walk through the numbers; happy to schedule.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.example
From: Ava Caulfield <ava@heliosbio.com>

Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interim seats added 10/1 — request pause on collection and refund guidance

Laura / Jonas — thanks for the clear plan. We're attaching the VAT certificate for Helios Bio and our internal PO (PO-11234).

A couple of quick clarifications:
- We will return the pilot seats effective 10/12, so please bill the seats through 10/11 (credit for 10/12 onward).
- Will the credit be issued grossed with VAT treatment on the credit line, or will you apply reverse-charge notation? Our accounting team expects a separate credit line with VAT indicated so they can net it against the original charge.

If you confirm the hold, we'll expect no automated collection notices while you complete the adjustment.

Attachments: helios_vat_certificate.pdf (pdf stub); PO-11234.pdf (pdf stub)

Appreciate the quick help here — please confirm once the hold is in place and an ETA on the credit posting.

Best,
Ava
